messages.subject: Project Onyx - SSA v3 (our response)
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Our response is attached (v3, tracked over your v2). We've accepted the Investor Majority at 50 per cent and the £150k litigation threshold. We've brought the warranty cap to £20m and adjusted the de minimis and basket accordingly. We'd like to keep the non-compete at 12 months. On the limitation period we can live with 18 months if Calderbrook drops the MFN in the Investor Rights Agreement.

If agreeable in principle we'll move to execution versions and the completion checklist.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
